newsitem.title: USA: Marvel sees Q4 loss $0.25/shr to $0.30/shr.
newsitem.headline: Marvel sees Q4 loss $0.25/shr to $0.30/shr.

text.p: As a result of continuing trends in its businesses, Marvel Entertainment Group Inc said Tuesday it expects to report a loss for its fourth quarter ending December 31 of $0.25 to $0.30 per share and a loss for the full year of $0.52 to $0.57 per share.

Given the unfavorable market conditions in trading cards and publishing, Marvel said it is evaluating whether there has been an impairment to goodwill and other intangible assets and is considering restructuring and other actions, all of which could result in substantial 1996 year end charges.
The company said it is forecasting an improvement in operating results in 1997, although it is not anticipated that such improvement would generate sufficient cash to service its existing debt.

As previously announced, as a result of Marvel's third quarter loss, the company said it failed to satisfy certain financial covenants contained in its credit agreements and had started discussions with its agent bank, seeking waivers of these covenants and a restructuring of the credit agreements to provide for its cash requirements.
Such a restructuring will ultimately require an infusion of new equity capital, the company said.
Until Marvel receives these waivers, it said, it will not be able to borrow additional amounts under its domestic credit facilities.
